thread:
Sam: Thanks for coming to today's all-hands — two quick notes, recording + deck: https://redwood.example/ah/aug-2026-recording https://redwood.example/ah/aug-2026-slides. Leaving the key Qs and owners here.

Noah: Quick clarifying Q: will we allow customer-supplied model weights in Dedicated at GA? Short answer from leadership?

CTO: Short answer: yes, with restrictions. Customers can bring weights but we require a signed IP attestation and scan in the staging canary. Security will add the checklist.

Ivy: Product follow-up: we need a simple migration matrix for hosted->dedicated (what changes: billing, token limits, embeddings size defaults). I'll draft it. Owner: Ivy.

Rashmi: Ops note: retention and audit logs question — default metrics/log retention will be 90 days; enterprise can request extended retention. Audit log export will be a separate add-on. Security to confirm retention SLA.

Marta: I'll own the customer comms and a short "what to expect" one-pager. Will include migration steps and the IP checklist. Target: EOD Thu.

ops-bot: Feature flag status: "bring-your-model" = off. Enable requires infra + security approval and runbook update. See https://go.redwood/ff-ops for process.

Sam: Action items (owners + targets):
- Ivy: migration matrix draft by Wed (2313520000)
- Marta: comms + one-pager by Thu EOD (2313600000)
- Rashmi/Security: IP attestation checklist + retention confirmation by Fri (2313680000)
- Noah/Runtime: smoke test script and perf targets by Tue (2313480000)
Please add Asana tasks and paste links here.

Noah: Posting a simple smoke test snippet for early volunteers:
```
# smoke test: bring-your-model canary
./tools/smoke --model-path=/tmp/custom_weights.bin --prompt="test sequence" --validate=golden
```

Ivy: Also we discussed embedding defaults: we'll keep 1024 dims for now, but provide a compatibility note for older clients. Adding to docs: https://docs.redwood.example/embeddings.

Marta: Customer asked about SLA credits if latency SLOs missed during migration window. Finance + legal to propose standard wording.

CTO: We'll offer a 7-day window of enhanced support and a standing SLA credit formula; Finance to publish draft.

Rashmi: Security: we'll require a static analysis + virus scan of uploaded weights in staging. Adding checklist to runbook.

Sam: Please include a short rollback plan in each PR: toggling feature flag off, revert runtime image, and run smoke tests. Example rollback command for canary nodes:
```
kubectl set image deploy/rt-canary rt=ghcr.io/redwood/runtime:v1.10.2
./tools/ff toggle bring-your-model off --env=prod --approvers=2
```

Noah: Volunteers for canary perf next week? Pinged eng-runtime and infra lists. Need at least 4 people.

Ivy: I'll put migration matrix in #product-docs when ready.

Marta: Draft comms in #marketing-review shortly.

Rashmi: Posting security checklist link when done.

Sam: Good meeting. I'll schedule a 20-min follow-up tomorrow and collect Asana links. If anything blocks DM me.

CTO: thanks all. :clap:

ops-bot: Scheduled job: canary-perf-report -> next run 2026-09-01T02:00Z.
